name: A01_4_the_opponents_flying_creature_spells_are_not_reduced
notes: Printed: 'Creature spells with flying YOU cast cost {1} less to cast.' The opponent (seat 1) has three Islands and Mistral Singer ({2}{U}, printed flying) in hand. On its own turn it casts the Singer with the game's own payment and pays the FULL {2}{U}: all three Islands are tapped (a reduction would have left one untapped). Seat 0's Watcher does not buff itself for the opponent's flier either: it stays 2/2.
